The Challenge by Dr. Frederik Polak of Amsterdam 

Cheers and notes by Richard Cowan, and thanks to Allen St. Pierre, as always. 

(MarijuanaNews note: Last week, the so-called United Nations Committee on Narcotic Drugs met in Vienna, supposedly to hear different views from Non-Governmental Organizations involved in the “drugs issues.” However, like all enemies of freedom, they did not want to hear any dissent, but there were a number of anti-prohibitionists in attendance. 

My good friend Dr. Frederick Polak, of the Amsterdam Health Department raised an unwelcome question, and demanded an answer, speaking truth to power. Also, it is great to see the Hungarians standing up for freedom, again. 

Please send this article to everyone you know so they can see it, and hear the prohibitionist party hacks clap for the Czar’s arrogance, just as their soul-mates once clapped for Stalin. 

Then they read the facts for themselves.) 

Documenting the facts and Costa’s record of lying. 

See 

International “Prohibition Situation Report” – DEAland Media Ignore News Showing Cannabis Prohibition Is Counterproductive. Coffee Shop System Survives. and links, especially from 2003,

see 

UN Nark's Speech To Swedish Prohibitionists May Cause Permanent Brain Damage. Illogic, Ignorance and Lying, Especially About the Dutch, Of Course. 

From Allen St. Pierre: 

UN Drug Czar Refuses To Answer Question on Dutch Marijuana Policy “Our friends at the Hungarian Civil Liberties Union captured a great moment from the United Nations Committee on Narcotic Drugs where Antonio Maria Costa refused to answer a question about why the Netherlands has a lower marijuana usage rate than surrounding countries. Not only does Costa refuse to answer, but he is visibly agitated at the question and the questioner.” 

Enjoy, 

-Allen
